bio: The theme is ‘Cucina Tokyonese’, Italian cuisine in the Tokyo style. The focus is on vegetables from Setagaya and other ingredients from the Tokyo area. In keeping with the belief that what can be made in-house should be, herbs and fruits are grown in the garden and seasonings are prepared on site. The restaurant’s name means ‘we’ in Italian, expressing a desire for diners to enjoy cuisine created collectively by everyone involved, including the producers.
